name: process.kill
description: Terminate a process by pid via TerminateProcess. Hard kill — no graceful shutdown signal; the process gets no chance to save state.

pid.description: Process id to terminate. Must refer to a running process owned by the agent's account (or any account if the agent has SeDebugPrivilege).

exit_code.description: Exit code reported to TerminateProcess. The terminated process's wait return value will reflect this.

x-output-schema.description: Empty body — wire response is the literal `OK 0`.

x-implementations.name: open_process_terminate
x-implementations.description: Win32 `OpenProcess(PROCESS_TERMINATE, ...)` + `TerminateProcess(hProcess, exit_code)`. ERR not_found when OpenProcess fails (process exited, or pid was reused for an inaccessible process); ERR permission_denied when TerminateProcess is denied (protected process, cross-account without SeDebugPrivilege).

windows-modern.description: OpenProcess + TerminateProcess. Protected processes (anti-cheat, antivirus, system services) reject TerminateProcess even with SeDebugPrivilege; ERR permission_denied. Children of the killed process are NOT cascaded — use a job object pattern (out of scope for this verb) or kill children individually first.

windows-classic.description: Same APIs across NT 4 / 9x onwards. NT 4 / 9x lack SeDebugPrivilege — cross-account kills fail unless the agent runs as SYSTEM.
